overallSummary: 本期筛选显示拼多多、CoStar 集团及阿尔伯特森斯等个股获多位价值投资者共识，其中段永平重仓加仓拼多多与特斯拉，查克·阿克瑞增持 CoStar 集团，帕伯莱大举加仓阿尔伯特森斯，均释放强烈信心信号。同时，Meta 因安全边际回落跌出候选清单，侧面印证当前持仓质量的高标准。

stockNotes.name: 卡夫亨氏
stockNotes.holderText: 巴菲特（2.8%仓位，持有40季/10.0年，仓位未变）

stockNotes.verdictEn: Deep discount with a long-held, unchanged position, though the position size is not large, looks more like a low-cost core holding than a fresh buy signal.

stockNotes.holderText: 段永平（10.1%仓位，持有11季/2.8年，近3季连续加仓，本季加仓）；大卫·泰珀（1.5%仓位，持有12季/3.0年，近3季连续减仓，本季减仓）

stockNotes.verdictEn: High consensus but the discount is shallow, but holders are diverging (some adding, some trimming) — worth watching but not chasing. Li Lu (5.1%) also holds this stock, but the margin of safety hasn't reached the 10% threshold yet, so it is not counted among the consensus holders.
